title: Concept: Test tooling is installed into the production dependency tree
description: composer.json declares a test-only package declared in `require`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a test-only package declared in `require`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a test-only package declared in `require`.
